title: Minutes of the meeting of the {body}
section_order: header: body, date, time, location, chair
Present / In attendance / Apologies (name, role, initials)
Welcome, apologies and declarations of interest
numbered agenda items: discussion, Decision, Actions
noting: The Board received a report on {x}.
decision: The Board approved {x}, subject to the following: {conditions}

action.deadline: only if set: 'by {date}'; otherwise leave the action log's date empty

votes: rare in UK boards; US boards: 'Motion … seconded … carried unanimously'
sign_off: Signed by the Chair as a correct record at the next meeting
omit: small talk and procedure beyond opening and closing
patient names (cases are counted or described)
